en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with a prominent monument at its center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with a standing figure on top and seated figures at the corners, surrounded by steps. Historic multi‑storey buildings encircle the square; signs on the façades advertise banks, cafés, and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the open plaza. The caption "GRAZ – HAUPTPLATZ" appears at the bottom left, and the publisher credit "ERIKA-VERLAG-GRAZ. 522" is printed at the bottom right. Other building signs include "STEIERM. AGRAR BANK" and "CAFÉ NORDSTER".
